name: bunny-inc
description: Reads Bunny subscription-billing data (accounts, contacts, invoices, payments, subscriptions) from the per-tenant Bunny GraphQL API. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external Bunny, Inc. API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
